title_en: At the Botanical Garden, Duplex For Sale With Ample Spaces And Perfect Orientation!!!
description_en: At the Botanical Garden in the Fratari Residence, a duplex with ample space and perfect orientation is for sale. The duplex with a gross area of 229.6 m2, net 219.5 m2, veranda 101.4 m2 is located on the 3rd floor of a well-managed 4-storey building with an elevator, and is organized on the first floor with a living room, a separate kitchen with access to the veranda, a toilet and a storage room, on the second floor 4 bedrooms, two of which with dedicated toilets and a main toilet. The orientation of the apartment is South-East-West, which allows natural light and sun throughout the day. The area in which the apartment is located is characterized by the peace and clean air it offers. The property has full mortgage documentation.
